foreground.description: Detailed description of the main subjects visible in the foreground. Do not invent details.

background.description: Detailed description of the background, environment, distant subjects and setting. Sky is NOT part of the background. Do not invent details.

lighting.description: Description of the illumination conditions, including light source, intensity, direction and shadows. Choose exactly one of the allowed values.
enum: Soft, diffuse natural light with subtle shadows
Combination of natural and artificial light
Nighttime with little or no ambient light

weather.description: Description of atmospheric and weather conditions. Choose exactly one of the allowed values.
enum: Clear, with little or no cloud cover
Partly cloudy, with patches of clear sky
